neutral_facts.correct_value: The victim, an accused in a separate criminal case, engaged the accused advocate. He alleged excessive fees of about Rs. 7.05 lakh, no active assistance, and withdrawal. He sought a refund of at least Rs. 6 lakh. The accused said appropriate fees were charged for services rendered. The complaint was examined by the Bar Council of Delhi.
neutral_facts.quote: the Bar Council of Delhi ... held that to the extent of Rs.4 lacs, the prayer of the complainant is justified
neutral_facts.reason: Summary asserts unstated non-refund and reports Bar Council findings, which are proceeding outcomes rather than trial-stage prosecution evidence.
